detail.longDescription:
One powerful remote control for all TVs!

Your TV controller is getting lost? Or do you simply want to have an easy control of your TV? Maybe you want to open the apps and channels quickly? If so, you’re in luck - remote control application can help to remove these problems from your life.

UniRemote·Universal TV Control lifts your TV-watching experience!
It allows you to control your TV from your iPhone. It duplicates the main functions of a traditional remote control, enabling you to manage everything: channels, volume, navigation menu, and other controls (Play/Pause/Stop, etc.) with D-pad, Touchpad, and Numpad.
You only need to connect your iPhone and your TV to the same Wi-Fi network—your phone’s touchscreen will become a comprehensive control panel.

KEY FEATURES:

- Intuitive interface: Extended remote control functionality with responsive touchpad, quick keyboard search, default browser access and more.
- Easy Mode: Allows to customize and simplify the remote screen with bigger-sized navigation and volume controls.
- Automatic setup: The app automatically detects TVs on your network, allowing you to control via your phone.
- Haptic feedback: Provides a satisfying vibration for a realistic feel.
- Media casting: Cast photos and videos from your phone with a few clicks.
- Multi-device support: Connect and switch between multiple TV devices without effort.

UniRemote·Universal TV Control is a fully functional mobile version of a traditional TV remote. You can stay on the couch with no need to find or buy a new remote if it’s lost. You can browse your favorite shows, movies, and programs using your phone right after the app syncs with your device. It's a smart technology for a more comfortable life!

Disclaimer:
UniRemote·Universal TV Control is NOT the official application of Samsung, LG, Sony, Philips, Panasonic, and other brands and is NOT affiliated with these or other companies.

Troubleshooting Note:
- For Smart TV devices: Make sure your TV device and iPhone are connected to the same Wifi network.
- For IR (infrared) TVs: Your smartphone must have a built-in Infrared (IR) feature to use the app as a remote control.

Premium:
To receive full access to Universal Remote TV ControlUniRemote·Universal TV Control features, you will need to subscribe to Premium.

Subscription Information:
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
The cost of the renewal depends on your subscription plan.
Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off in the user’s Account Settings.
Any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.
